claims.statement: Wispr Flow provides system-wide AI dictation, automatic editing, context-aware formatting, and multilingual use across desktop and mobile.
Wispr Flow Pro costs $12 per user each month. The free plan allows 2,000 words per week on desktop, 1,000 on iPhone, and unlimited dictation on Android.
Wispr Flow always processes dictation in the cloud. Privacy Mode controls model training, while Private Cloud Sync separately controls whether transcription data is stored on Wispr's servers.
Context Awareness can read nearby text and app information. Its screen OCR option is off by default and only captures a screenshot when both context controls are enabled.
Fast writing, strong dictation accuracy, useful cleanup, and cross-app use are repeated positive themes.
The Mac experience is repeatedly described as stronger and easier than the Windows, iPhone, and iPad experiences.
Privacy, cloud processing, screenshot context, resource use, device friction, and free-tier limits are recurring concerns.

Digital Macaroni emailed Wispr Flow support four times over one month. The third contact received a template asking for information already supplied, support assisted after the fourth contact, and the final follow-up was left unread.

scoreRationale.onboarding: The hold-to-speak pattern and cross-app behavior are easy to understand, but setup, permissions, and platform differences add friction.
scoreRationale.product: Users repeatedly praise speed, accuracy, and cleanup. Uneven experiences outside the Mac version keep the product score below the top tier.
scoreRationale.support: Digital Macaroni contacted support four times over one month. Help came only after the fourth contact, after a template response repeated an already answered question, and the final follow-up was left unread.
scoreRationale.billing: The free tier creates a useful trial path. Pro is $12 per user each month, and its value depends on whether unlimited dictation replaces enough typing to become a daily habit.
scoreRationale.overall: The four component scores average 7.55, rounded to 7.6. Strong speed and product feedback are offset by a 5.5 support experience, platform differences, and privacy concerns.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Product Hunt and G2 feedback is strongly positive while device-specific and community feedback is more mixed.
No new hands-on test was completed.
The product changes quickly, so platform reliability and billing limits need future checks.
